short_horizon_movement_propagates.meaning: short-horizon price movement propagates into spotEMA faster than into longer-horizon EMAs

twap_heavily_smoothed.meaning: the TWAP used in liquidation checks is a heavily smoothed blend of fastEMA, slowEMA and eonsEMA, with eonsEMA included and spotEMA excluded

stale_oracle_boundary_outcome_altered.meaning: the altered TWAP changes StaleOracle boundary outcomes so the system proceeds when it should revert as stale, or reverts when it should proceed

assumptions: The TWAP computed by RiskEngine.twapEMA() is the value fed into PanopticPool.getTWAP() and the StaleOracle gate.
Impacts are potential/conditional, not observed incidents.

unresolved.description: Report gives no numeric definition of the StaleOracle boundary threshold or of the EMA values, so the boundary-outcome change is represented as a grounded Boolean rather than a numeric comparison.

limitations: The smoothing blend is represented as a qualitative Boolean because the report supplies no numeric EMA values or weights for the intended formula beyond the root-cause description.
No concrete actor or transaction is described; the scenario is conditional on short-horizon movement propagating into spotEMA.
